operations.name: Tina Lowe

expected.name: Tina Lowe
expected.description: Tina Lowe was imprisoned for an October 1979 trespass protest at the Trident submarine base at Bangor, Washington. A January 17, 1982 contemporary prisoner-support newsletter lists her at the federal correctional institution in Pleasanton, California, and reports a six-month sentence imposed November 16, 1981 after she refused to promise not to trespass at the base again.
expected.body: Source: National No-Nukes Prison Support Collective newsletter, January 17, 1982, page 2. Custody is historical; an exact release date has not been verified.

operations.note: Follow-up source establishes historical release; transition newly added unknown status to released.

operations.name: Tom Joyce

expected.charges: Depredation of government property during a Pentagon antiwar protest.
expected.sentence: Held after refusing personal-recognizance release; continued confinement after January 8, 1982 documented. The reported one-year maximum is not an imposed sentence. Actual release date unverified.

operations.note: Explicit January29 release and dismissal. Do not record offered guilty plea: Joyce refused it.

operations.name: Tom Joyce

expected.name: Tom Joyce
expected.description: Tom Joyce, identified as a Toronto peace activist, was arrested during a December 30, 1981 antiwar blood-pouring action at the Pentagon. He refused release on personal recognizance and remained in the D.C. jail. A January 17, 1982 prisoner-support report confirms continued custody after a January 8 court appearance.
expected.body: Source: National No-Nukes Prison Support Collective newsletter, January 17, 1982, page 1. Custody is historical; an exact release date has not been verified.

operations.note: Follow-up source establishes historical release; transition newly added unknown status to released.
